liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playing In The Band** (4 reviews): Ned Lagin's playing helps make this one of 1974's spaciest, most interesting Playin' versions; Playin' features heavy Fender Rhodes keyboard playing and is called monstrous [12][13][14][21]
- **Eyes Of The World** (3 reviews): Eyes of the World is described as a truly nasty, hard-hitting performance; Eyes, a few songs into Set 2, is called incredible, with notable interplay among Jerry, Bobby and Phil [19][20][22]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet is called a sweet version that stands on its own, not paired with another song; Scarlet shows their exploration of the song before it was paired with Fire on the Mountain in '77 [13][22]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Black-Throated Wind is said to soar [20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): China Cat into Rider is described as raunchy [13]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' flows into Nobody's Jam, then two Mind Left Body jams, ending in Wharf Rat; reviewer calls it essential [12]
- **Nobody's Jam** (1 review): Nobody's Jam is named as this reviewer's highlight of the show [18]

## The recordings

- **gd74-06-16.sbd.cribbs.26452.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 232 min; rated 4.22/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.fink.15781.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 232 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [2]
- **gd74-06-16.sbd.fink.17701.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 232 min; rated 4.47/5 by 47 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the sound quality spotty; Drums dominate the mix for roughly the first two minutes of Bertha, and a dropout comes later; The EQ seems to have taken a while to get right during the recording [16][17][18][19]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.bryan.207.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 231 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Bertha has a splice at 4:04, with serious mix problems before it [5]
- **gd1974-06-16.143135.sbd.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 14 songs; 124 min [10]. Said about its sound: A number of small dropouts were repaired, including in Eyes of the World [10]

## Around the show

- Ned Lagin's electronic noises spoil a few songs for this reviewer [16]
- Reviewer ranks this show just below the next one, in Louisville, KY [14]
- Reviewer pairs this show with 6/18 as companions, both with strong Wall of Sound character [14]
- Reviewer found more energy here than expected, given how often 1974 shows, especially late ones, lack it [18]
- May-June 1974 was a peak period; reviewer says the band didn't reach such a plateau again until May '77 [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-06-16.sbd.cribbs.26452.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Mixed soundboard sources: Set 1 from MSR to C to DAT to CD; Sets 2 and 3 come from MSC to DAT to CD, except a Wharf Rat patch from an MSR source [1]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.fink.15781.shnf**: transferred by Alan Fink; source: S : MR > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN [2]. Also: Fink's SHN set came via Robert Naylor; the files are described as not seekable [2]
- **gd74-06-16.sbd.fink.17701.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1974-06-16.sbd.bryan.207.shnf**: transferred by Michael Bryan; source: SBDMR>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: Sets 2 and 3 come from an unknown-generation reel source, extracted with EAC and converted to SHN by Michael Bryan [5]
- **gd1974-06-16.143135.sbd.partial.gastwirt.sirmick.miller.flac1644**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: SBD > MR > Dat (44.1k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt [10]. Also: Source drawn from DATs supplied by Rich, part of a new-source release effort begun by Charlie Miller in January 2017 [10]
